_schema: One JSON object per line — the growth agent's structured engagement-experiment log (append-only). Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), rubric_lever (e.g. R1), hypothesis (one line), files (list of prompt files changed), commit (sha), predicted ({metric, dir:up|down}), baseline_note (measured baseline at ship time), status (running|measuring|promoted|reverted), verdict (null until settled). The agent skips any line containing _schema.

hypothesis: A list beat's span is set by cue spacing, not by how long its enumeration takes to speak, and render_list stretched the row reveals across the whole span (step=(dur-0.8)/n). On long beats the card therefore sat incomplete for most of its life and the final point landed seconds after the narrator said it — near-zero information gain per second on the beats that occupy the most screen time. Capping the inter-row step at 1.1s completes the card early while leaving tight, well-fitted beats untouched.
